agent_not_found: That agent no longer exists. Reload the page.
agent_revoked: This agent is revoked: it can't change any more.
app_action_has_point: This action runs through its payment route, not as an app action.
app_exists: An app with that key already exists.
app_installed_from_other_url: An app with this key is installed from another manifest URL, so this request can't replace it.
app_installed_from_url: An app with this key is installed from its own site; a private app needs another key.
app_is_private: A private app changes by uploading its manifest again.
app_not_installed: This app isn't installed, so it has no access to reduce.
app_unavailable: The app didn't answer. Try again in a moment.
asset_in_use: This file is used on products. Remove it from them first.
asset_kind_not_allowed: Products take images and videos; a variant shows an image.
asset_not_found: That file is no longer in the media library.
asset_not_public: That image is private. Emails can only show public images: change its visibility on the Media page.
catalog_exists: This market already has a catalog.
category_cycle: A category can't move under itself or one of its subcategories.
category_handle_taken: Another category has that handle. Handles are unique across categories.
category_has_children: This category has subcategories. Move or delete them first.
category_not_found: That category no longer exists. Reload the page.
category_parent_not_found: That parent category no longer exists. Reload the page.
channel_name_taken: Another channel already has that name.
checkout_rule_not_found: That checkout rule no longer exists. Reload the page.
compare_at_not_above_price: A compare-at price must be above the price.
concurrent_modification: Someone else changed this at the same time. Reload and try again.
country_in_other_market: A country you chose is already in another market. A country belongs to one market.
country_in_other_zone: A country you listed is already in another zone. A country ships from one zone.
custom_field_definition_not_found: That field no longer exists. Reload the page.
custom_field_exists: Another field of this kind of record already has that key.
custom_field_managed: An app or spore declares this field, so it can't be changed here.
custom_field_not_filterable: A filter names a custom field that isn't filterable.
custom_field_read_only: One of these fields is read-only: its app manages it.
custom_field_stale: Someone else changed a custom field meanwhile. Reload to see it, then try again.
custom_field_unknown: A filter names a custom field that doesn't exist any more.
custom_field_values_invalid: Some stored values break the new rules. Fix them first, or loosen the rules.
custom_field_values_invalid_count: {count, plural, one {# stored value breaks} other {# stored values break}} the new rules. Fix them first, or loosen the rules.
custom_fields_invalid: Some custom fields aren't valid: see the marked fields.
default_language_in_use: The content language can't change while the store has translations: each one is a translation from it. Remove the translations first.
default_language_listed: That language is one of the store's other languages. Remove it from the list first.
duplicate_adjustment_target: A product or category is named twice.
duplicate_option_combination: Another variant already has these option values.
duplicate_option_name: Two options have the same name.
duplicate_option_value: An option has the same value twice.
duplicate_price_list: The market already uses that price list.
email_not_configured: Emails are only written to the server log, so a test would reach nobody. Set up a sender under [email] in hypha.config.toml.
email_refused: The email provider refused the message: {error}
email_unavailable: The email provider couldn't be reached. Try again in a moment. ({error})
enabled_not_per_language: Whether an email is sent is one switch for every language: change it on the content language's template.
empty_option: Every option needs at least one value.
ends_not_after_start: The end must be after the start.
file_too_large: That file is too large: images up to 20 MB, videos up to 1 GB, PDFs up to 100 MB.
filterable_not_allowed: Multi-line text, rich text and JSON fields can't be filters.
fixed_price_currency_mismatch: A fixed price must be in the price list's currency.
fixed_prices_invalid: Some fixed prices aren't valid: see the rows marked.
footer_too_long: The footer can be at most 1,000 characters.
fulfillment_has_no_lines: Choose at least one item to ship.
grant_not_narrower: Access can only be reduced here. To add a scope, the app asks again and staff approve it.
handle_taken: Another product already uses that handle. Pick a different one.
instructions_too_long: Instructions can be at most 2,000 characters.
invalid_address: An address needs a last name, a first line and a city, each up to 255 characters.
invalid_app_key: Keys are app_ followed by lowercase letters, digits and '_', like app_erp.
invalid_basis_points: A discount can't be more than 100%.
invalid_callback_timeout: The timeout is between 100 and 10,000 milliseconds.
invalid_callback_url: The callback URL must start with https:// (http:// only for localhost).
invalid_checkout_rule: Check the highlighted parts of the rule.
invalid_colour: The accent colour is six hex digits after a #, like #1a2b3c.
invalid_country_code: Countries are two-letter codes, like HR or DE.
invalid_custom_field_key: The key is 2 to 64 lowercase letters, digits and _, starting with a letter.
invalid_email: That isn't a valid email address.
invalid_extension_context: The app's action doesn't fit here. Reload the page.
invalid_language: Write the language as a BCP 47 tag, like en, en-GB or sr-Latn.
invalid_mfa_code: That code didn't work. Check your authenticator app and try again.
invalid_order_url: The order link must be an http(s) URL with '{'order'}' in it, and no placeholders but '{'order'}' and '{'token'}'.
invalid_payment_provider: This build of Hypha doesn't have that payment provider.
invalid_payment_transition: The payment can't change that way any more. Reload the order.
invalid_refund_amount: That's more than is left to refund.
invalid_shipping_option_code: Codes are lowercase letters, digits, '_' and '-', like standard or next-day.
invalid_shipping_provider_key: Keys are app_ followed by lowercase letters, digits and '_', like app_courier.
invalid_subscription: Events are types like order.placed, a kind like product.*, or * for all.
invalid_timeout: The webhook timeout is between 1,000 and 30,000 milliseconds.
invalid_tracking_url: The tracking link must start with https:// or http://.
invalid_translation: Some fields couldn't be saved. Check the highlighted fields.
invite_not_found: That invite was already accepted or withdrawn. Reload the page.
language_in_use: A market still offers that language. Take it off the market first.
language_is_default: That's the store's content language already; it needs no translation.
language_not_listed: That language is no longer one of the store's languages. Reload the page.
language_not_offered: A market can offer only the store's content language and its published languages.
last_country: A market keeps at least one country. Add another before removing this one.
last_owner: The store keeps at least one active owner. Make someone else an owner first.
location_not_found: That location doesn't exist any more. Reload and pick another.
manifest_unreachable: The app's manifest couldn't be read.
media_not_configured: File storage isn't set up for this store yet.
mfa_locked: Too many wrong codes. Try again in a few minutes.
mfa_setup_not_started: That setup expired. Start setting up the authenticator again.
missing_scope: Your role doesn't allow this. Ask the store owner for access.
no_countries: A market needs at least one country.
no_variants: A product keeps at least one variant.
not_allowed_to_grant: You can only give away scopes your own role has.
notification_failed: The email couldn't be sent. Check the email settings under Notifications, then try again.
notification_not_found: That email record no longer exists. Reload the page.
notification_not_resendable: Invites and password resets can't be resent: send a new invite or reset instead.
oauth_request_expired: This request expired: requests wait ten minutes. Start again from the app.
oauth_request_not_found: That authorization request doesn't exist. Start the installation again from the app.
option_value_in_use: Variants still use the values you removed.
order_has_fulfillments: Take back the order's shipments first, then cancel it.
over_fulfilled: That's more than is left to ship.
over_fulfilled_left: That's more than is left to ship: {left, number} of that item.
owner_role_fixed: The owner role always has every scope; it can't be changed.
password_too_long: The password can be at most 128 characters.
password_too_short: Use at least 8 characters for the password.
payment_action_unsupported: This payment's provider can't do that.
payment_method_in_use: An order is still waiting for a payment by this method. Turn the method off instead, so shoppers stop seeing it.
payment_method_not_found: That payment method no longer exists. Reload the page.
payment_provider_unknown: This build of Hypha doesn't have that payment provider.
personal_not_allowed: Only customers' and orders' fields can hold personal data.
preview_stale: The store changed since the agent proposed this: approving now would do something else, so nothing was applied.
price_list_currency_mismatch: A market's price list must be in the market's currency.
price_list_in_use: Markets still use this price list. Take it off their catalogs first.
price_list_name_taken: Another price list has that name. Names are unique, ignoring case.
price_list_not_found: That price list no longer exists. Reload the page.
price_list_not_in_catalog: The market doesn't use that price list any more. Reload the page.
proposal_decided: Someone already decided this proposal. Reload the page.
proposal_expired: This proposal expired before anyone decided it.
proposal_not_found: That proposal no longer exists. Reload the page.
provider_app_not_found: There's no app with that key. Add the app first.
rate_limited_seconds: Too many attempts. Try again in {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}.
resource_not_found: What this translates no longer exists.
role_name_taken: Another role already has that name.
role_not_found: That role no longer exists. Reload the page.
role_scopes_required: A role needs at least one scope.
session_not_found: That device is already signed out. Reload the page.
session_required: Only a signed-in staff member can do this.
shipping_option_code_taken: Another option of this zone has that code.
shipping_provider_exists: A rate app with that key already exists.
shipping_provider_failed: The rate app didn't answer properly: {error}.
shipping_provider_timeout: The rate app didn't answer properly: {error}.
sku_taken: Another variant already uses that SKU. SKUs are unique across the store.
staff_only: Only a signed-in staff member can send a test: it goes to your own address.
store_description_too_long: The description can be at most 500 characters.
store_name_too_long: The store name can be at most 100 characters.
template_invalid: The template doesn't work. Check its variables and tags.
template_part_not_allowed: The layout only has HTML: leave its subject and plain text empty.
template_part_required: An email needs a subject and an HTML body.
template_required: This email can't be turned off: the layout, invites and password resets are always sent.
template_too_complex: The template takes too long to render: a loop runs too many times.
template_unknown: There's no such email template. Reload the page.
too_many_adjustment_targets: An adjustment names at most 1,000 products or categories.
too_many_checkout_rules: A store has at most 100 checkout rules. Delete one you no longer need.
too_many_custom_fields: There are too many fields for this kind of record.
too_many_filterable_custom_fields: A kind of record has at most 50 filterable fields.
too_many_languages: A store has at most 20 languages besides its content language.
too_many_media: A product has at most 250 media items.
too_many_operations: An allowlist names at most 1,000 operations.
too_many_price_lists: A market's catalog holds at most 50 price lists.
too_many_prices: At most 1,000 fixed prices can be saved at once.
too_many_shipping_options: A zone has at most 50 options.
too_many_subscriptions: An app subscribes to at most 50 event types.
too_many_variants: A product has at most 2,048 variants.
too_much_tracking: A shipment has at most 10 tracking numbers.
translation_into_default_language: That's the store's content language: edit the text itself instead.
translation_not_found: That translation no longer exists. Reload the page.
unique_not_allowed: Only single text, integer and URL fields can be unique.
unknown_country_code: That isn't an ISO country code. Use the two letters ISO assigned, like HR or DE.
unknown_timezone: Choose a time zone from the list.
unsupported_media_type: That file type isn't supported. Use JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, GIF, MP4, WebM, MOV or PDF.
upload_mismatch: The file's contents don't match its type. Export it again and retry.
user_exists: Someone with that email is already on the team.
user_not_found: That staff member no longer exists. Reload the page.
